title.zh: 将宿务省保和岛潘高市描笼涯洛尔德斯至描笼涯塔瓦拉通往保和—邦劳国际机场的道路命名为康斯坦西奥·查托·托拉尔巴总督路的法案
title.en: An Act Naming the Road Leading to the Bohol-Panglao International Airport, Stretching From Barangay Lourdes Up to Barangay Tawala in the Municipality of Panglao, Province of Bohol, as Governor Constancio Chatto Torralba Road
title.orig: An Act Naming the Road Leading to the Bohol-Panglao International Airport, Stretching From Barangay Lourdes Up to Barangay Tawala in the Municipality of Panglao, Province of Bohol, as Governor Constancio Chatto Torralba Road
title.vi: Đạo luật đặt tên tuyến đường dẫn tới Sân bay Quốc tế Bohol-Panglao, kéo dài từ Barangay Lourdes đến Barangay Tawala tại Thị xã Panglao, Tỉnh Bohol là Đường Thống đốc Constancio Chatto Torralba
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติตั้งชื่อถนนที่เชื่อมไปยังท่าอากาศยานนานาชาติโบฮอล–ปังลาโอซึ่งทอดยาวจากบารังไกย์ลูร์เดสถึงบารังไกย์ตาวาลาในอำเภอปังลาโอจังหวัดโบฮอลว่าถนนผู้ว่าราชการจังหวัดคอนสแตนซิโอชาโตโทรรัลบะ
title.id: Undang-Undang Penetapan Nama Jalan Menuju Bandar Udara Internasional Bohol-Panglao yang Membentang dari Barangay Lourdes hingga Barangay Tawala di Kotamadya Panglao, Provinsi Bohol sebagai Jalan Gubernur Constancio Chatto Torralba
title.ms: Akta Menamakan Jalan Menuju Lapangan Terbang Antarabangsa Bohol-Panglao yang Membentang dari Barangay Lourdes hingga Barangay Tawala di Perbandaran Panglao, Wilayah Bohol sebagai Jalan Datuk Bandar Constancio Chatto Torralba

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2022/ra_11847_2022.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The road leading to the Bohol-Panglao International Airport, stretching from Barangay Lourdes up to Barangay Tawala in the Municipality of Panglao, Province of Bohol, comprising a total distance of 3.68 kilometers, is hereby named as Governor Constancio Chatto Torralba Road.
The Department of Public Works and Highways shall issue the necessary rules, orders, and circulars to implement the provisions of this Act within sixty (60) days from its effectivity.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
